title: Boom Boom Tower
premise: Hit the beat. Launch the rockets.
summary: A Tower-inspired rhythm game built around four colors, accurate timing, and music-driven rocket patterns.
about: Match yellow, red, green, and blue rocket notes to the music. Choose a song and difficulty, learn its patterns, and work toward cleaner timing on each attempt.
Boom Boom Tower is in development. This site introduces the game and its control scheme; a public playable release is not available yet.

features.title: Four colored inputs
features.text: Follow the note colors and trigger the matching rocket actions.

features.title: Song-based challenges
features.text: Pick a track and difficulty, then learn the rhythm of its chart.

features.title: Timing at the center
features.text: Improve through practice as familiar patterns become faster and more demanding.

steps.title: Choose your challenge
steps.text: Select a song and a difficulty suited to the patterns you want to practice.

steps.title: Match each color
steps.text: Follow the incoming notes and use the corresponding rocket input in time with the music.

steps.title: Find a consistent rhythm
steps.text: Learn the chart, refine your timing, and try again when you want a cleaner run.

controls.action: Use the matching yellow, red, green, or blue action for each note.
Use the four mapped rocket inputs. Bindings are shown in the game.

availability: The game is still being developed. There is no public playable release or download on this page yet.
